blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has issued a proclamation designating additional parcels of land for inclusion in existing economic zones in Cavite. Marcos designated approximately 14,640 square meters of land in Barangay Sta. Rosa I in Noveleta, Cavite, for coverage in the existing Cavite Economic Zone II. The move is based on Proclamation No. 1460 posted on the Official Gazette on Wednesday.
